newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX to decrease Hub natgas futures margins Wed.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX to decrease Hub natgas futures margins Wed.

text.p: New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) said Wednesday it will decrease margins on its Henry Hub natural gas futures and spreads as of the close of business today.
The initial margins on outright positions for the first month will be lowered to $4,500 from $6,300 for clearing members; to $4,950 from $6,930 for members, and to $6,075 from $8,505 for customers.
For all other months, outright margins will be decreased to $3,500 from $4,000 for clearing members; to $3,850 from $4,400 for members, and to $4,725 from $5,400 for customers.
Margins on natural gas spreads involving the first month will be reduced to $3,000 from $3,800 for clearing members; to $3,300 from $4,180 for members, and to $4,050 from $5,130 for customers.
